//: dev environment (10.1.1-T1.1): what the local stack of 01.8.1 provides.
config = the EVIDGATE_* key surface this environment answers for; origin is the
value's source (matrix source.dev, checked by scripts/check-env-matrix.mjs) and
value is present only for a non-secret key whose value is a literal here.
probes = the liveness/readiness behaviour of the two processes (00 §9.1 paths);
ingress = the provider-neutral public/operator/internal split, implemented by the
dev stack by binding every listener to 127.0.0.1 (infra/compose.dev.yml,
.env.dev ASPNETCORE_URLS) and checked by scripts/smoke-environment.sh --env dev.
description: Local developer stack: PostgreSQL 18 and SeaweedFS in containers (infra/compose.dev.yml), Evidgate.Api and Evidgate.Worker under `dotnet watch` on the host, no public ingress at all — every listener is loopback-only. Started with scripts/dev/up.sh (01.8.1-T2).

EVIDGATE__DATABASE__CONNECTIONSTRING.from: .env.dev, literal in .env.dev.template with __EVIDGATE_APP_PASSWORD__ replaced by up.sh (Host=127.0.0.1;Port=5432;Database=evidgate;Username=evidgate_app)

EVIDGATE__IDENTITY__CUSTOMROLESENABLED.from: option default false (V1: built-in roles only, RECOMMENDATIONS 02-Q3)

EVIDGATE__ISOLATION__SELFCHECK.from: not set: the option default Required applies (the self-check runs against the dev database)

EVIDGATE__LOGIN__PUBLICBASEURL.from: not set: the dev stack has no https origin to register as a provider redirect URI, so both login routes answer 503 unavailable + Retry-After and everything else serves (02.3.1-T1.1); a developer who tunnels an https origin exports it in his own shell

EVIDGATE__OBJECT__ENDPOINT.from: the local SeaweedFS gateway — the same endpoint the EVIDGATE_S3_ENDPOINT dev-stack row declares, because the host processes talk to the same container

EVIDGATE__OBJECT__REGION.from: the SeaweedFS gateway's signing region (scripts/dev/up.sh signs with aws:amz:us-east-1:s3)

EVIDGATE__OBJECT__BUCKET.from: the bucket scripts/dev/up.sh creates and puts the pending/ 24 h lifecycle rule on (T18)

EVIDGATE__OBJECT__ACCESSKEY.from: .env.dev literal, the same local-only SeaweedFS identity as the EVIDGATE_S3_ACCESS_KEY dev-stack row (asserted equal to infra/seaweedfs/s3-config.json by scripts/dev/up.sh)

EVIDGATE__OBJECT__SECRETKEY.from: .env.dev literal, the same local-only SeaweedFS identity as the EVIDGATE_S3_SECRET_KEY dev-stack row (asserted equal to infra/seaweedfs/s3-config.json by scripts/dev/up.sh)

EVIDGATE__OIDC__GOOGLE__CLIENTID.from: not set: no Google client is registered for a local https origin, so the Google provider stays unconfigured and its two routes answer 503 (02.3.1-T1.2)

EVIDGATE__OIDC__GOOGLE__CLIENTSECRET.from: not set: the dev stack completes no federated login, so the secret is never materialised here; staging and prod resolve it through ISecretProvider from the provider secret store (10.1.1-T3)

EVIDGATE__OAUTH__GITHUB__CLIENTID.from: not set: no GitHub OAuth app is registered for a local https origin, so the GitHub provider stays unconfigured and both login routes answer 503 for it (02.3.1-T1.3)

EVIDGATE__OAUTH__GITHUB__CLIENTSECRET.from: not set: the dev stack completes no federated login, so the secret is never materialised here; staging and prod resolve it through ISecretProvider from the provider secret store (10.1.1-T3)

EVIDGATE__RUNS__CANCEL__SOFTSTOPDELAY.from: .env.dev, literal in .env.dev.template — the graceful window a producer gets before the kill deadline. Required at boot: no option default, a missing key binds to 00:00:00 and is refused

EVIDGATE__RUNS__CANCEL__KILLDELAY.from: .env.dev, literal in .env.dev.template — the instant execution is stopped whatever it is doing, and the moment the durable kill task is due. Required at boot and must be at least the soft-stop window

EVIDGATE__TASKS__SWEEPCONNECTIONSTRING.from: .env.dev, Username=evidgate_worker_sched with the __EVIDGATE_WORKER_SCHED_PASSWORD__ placeholder replaced by up.sh

EVIDGATE__TASKS__WORKERCONNECTIONSTRING.from: .env.dev, Username=evidgate_worker with the __EVIDGATE_WORKER_PASSWORD__ placeholder replaced by up.sh — the queue's service role (claim/ack/dispatch/prune); the app role holds INSERT only on public.task and public.outbox

EVIDGATE__TELEMETRY__OTLPENDPOINT.from: not set: the OTLP exporter stays off, because the dev stack runs no collector (10.3.1-T2 lands one; 00 §11 forbids a hard dependency on the backend)

EVIDGATE__WORKER__HEALTHADDRESS.from: the dev environment: .env.dev, literal in .env.dev.template — the loopback bind is what makes /internal/health/* unreachable off-host; the Api gets the same effect from ASPNETCORE_URLS

EVIDGATE_APP_PASSWORD.from: .env.dev, generated by up.sh from the __EVIDGATE_APP_PASSWORD__ placeholder (role evidgate_app; consumed through EVIDGATE__DATABASE__CONNECTIONSTRING)

EVIDGATE_DB_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD.from: .env.dev, generated by up.sh from the __EVIDGATE_DB_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD__ placeholder (compose superuser; bootstrap only)

EVIDGATE_MIGRATOR__COMMANDTIMEOUTSECONDS.from: option default 0 (no driver command timeout; the per-script server timeouts are the two keys below)

EVIDGATE_MIGRATOR__CONNECTIONSTRING.from: .env.dev, literal in .env.dev.template with __EVIDGATE_OWNER_PASSWORD__ replaced by up.sh (Username=evidgate_owner)

EVIDGATE_MIGRATOR__LOCKTIMEOUTSECONDS.from: option default 5 s (lock_timeout per script), 0 = disabled

EVIDGATE_MIGRATOR__MIGRATIONSPATH.from: not set: MigratorOptions resolves <checkout>/migrations by walking up to Evidgate.slnx

EVIDGATE_MIGRATOR__STATEMENTTIMEOUTSECON.from: option default 900 s (statement_timeout per script), 0 = disabled

EVIDGATE_OPERATOR_PASSWORD.from: .env.dev, generated by up.sh from the __EVIDGATE_OPERATOR_PASSWORD__ placeholder (role evidgate_operator, audited read-only)

EVIDGATE_OWNER_PASSWORD.from: .env.dev, generated by up.sh from the __EVIDGATE_OWNER_PASSWORD__ placeholder (role evidgate_owner; consumed through EVIDGATE_MIGRATOR__CONNECTIONSTRING)

EVIDGATE_PLATFORM_OPERATOR_PASSWORD.from: .env.dev, generated by up.sh from the __EVIDGATE_PLATFORM_OPERATOR_PASSWORD__ placeholder (role evidgate_platform_operator, the sole grantee of the system healing-switch definer; supplied to psql by the operator and never received by the Api or the Worker)

EVIDGATE_S3_ACCESS_KEY.from: .env.dev literal, asserted equal to infra/seaweedfs/s3-config.json by scripts/dev/up.sh (local-only identity)

EVIDGATE_S3_SECRET_KEY.from: .env.dev literal, asserted equal to infra/seaweedfs/s3-config.json by scripts/dev/up.sh (local-only identity)

EVIDGATE_SEAWEEDFS_S3_CONFIG.from: scripts/dev/up.sh exports the content of infra/seaweedfs/s3-config.json; compose writes it to /etc/seaweedfs/s3-config.json inside the container

EVIDGATE_WORKER_PASSWORD.from: .env.dev, generated by up.sh from the __EVIDGATE_WORKER_PASSWORD__ placeholder (role evidgate_worker; consumed through EVIDGATE__TASKS__WORKERCONNECTIONSTRING)

EVIDGATE_WORKER_SCHED_PASSWORD.from: .env.dev, generated by up.sh from the __EVIDGATE_WORKER_SCHED_PASSWORD__ placeholder (role evidgate_worker_sched; consumed through EVIDGATE__TASKS__SWEEPCONNECTIONSTRING)

api.baseUrlNote: ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://127.0.0.1:8080 in .env.dev; the probe runs on the workstation, where the Api runs as a host process

worker.baseUrlNote: EVIDGATE__WORKER__HEALTHPORT=8081; scripts/dev/up.sh waits for this exact URL before it exits 0

ingress.note: Dev has no public ingress: every listener binds a loopback address — compose publishes 127.0.0.1:${EVIDGATE_DB_PORT} and 127.0.0.1:${EVIDGATE_S3_PORT}, the Api binds http://127.0.0.1:8080 from ASPNETCORE_URLS, and the Worker's health listener binds EVIDGATE__WORKER__HEALTHADDRESS=127.0.0.1. scripts/smoke-environment.sh --env dev asserts both health paths answer on the internal address, that every listener of the probed ports is loopback-only, and that the internal path is refused on a non-loopback address (00 §9.1).
